description: Create a role in the brand's Discord server: name, color, whether it shows separately in the member list (hoist), whether it can be @mentioned, and optionally its permissions by name. Unset permissions start as the server's @everyone permissions. Nobody holds a new role until assign_discord_role gives it. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

color.description: a hex color like #5865F2, or a whole number

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

hoist.description: show its members as their own group in the member list

name.description: the role name, up to 100 characters

permissions.description: what the role may do, as Discord permission names (e.g. ["VIEW_CHANNEL","SEND_MESSAGES"]) or a bitfield string. The bot can only grant permissions it has itself

name: create_discord_role
title: Create a Discord role
